dependency_limits: Only the 534-checkpoint paper matrix and explicitly selected scoring/preprocessing/runtime support are entrypoints.
Historical names retained only as imported dependency or explicit source-hash reference; not independently selected paper models.
Static file-level AST closure includes lazy imports; explicit dynamic vendor models and checkpoint code_hashes supplement it. No model registry enumeration.
Data, weights, logs, results JSON, snapshots, nested .git, images and unrelated vendor trees excluded.

Original relative paths preserved. Source bytes match source_sha256 except documented path-only portability fixes; destination bytes use sha256. No fixed source-server project/home path is an executable default.
Only matched TimeMixer CD is a paper baseline. The original shared TimeMixer.py is kept byte-for-byte, but its unselected lazy historical architecture imports are outside this closure.
The legacy external helper modules require the existing canonical compatibility wrapper; this is documented and tested without introducing historical training code.
PhaseFormer Lightning fallback follows the original adapter. Actual Lightning training is outside the paper runner path.
Forward checks use synthetic histories and untrained initialization on CPU. This migration does not certify checkpoint accuracy or data availability; runtime/asset acceptance is handled separately.
Small protocol JSON may retain original absolute strings as historical provenance; executable defaults and archived artifact pointer consumers use this checkout.
